visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair, wearing a grey off-the-shoulder top and a denim skirt, sits beside a man with short black hair in a black t-shirt. She holds a black plastic wrapper. Her facial expression is cheerful as she gestures towards the camera. The setting is an indoor room with a light beige wall and a grey couch. Several plush toys, including a large yellow Winnie the Pooh, are visible behind them. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The woman uses her hands to peel open the wrapper, revealing a black rectangular ice cream bar on a wooden stick. A small white animated character overlay appears near the ice cream. She raises the bar to her mouth and takes a large bite, her eyes widening slightly. The man watches her closely, leaning in. The lighting remains consistent as they interact with the food item. (3) The man reaches for the ice cream bar and takes a bite. His mouth moves as he chews and he looks directly at the woman while speaking. The woman smiles and watches him. She holds a small pink object in her hand later. The background remains the same with the plushies clearly visible on the couch. (4) The couple poses together for the camera. The man holds the mostly eaten ice cream stick, and they both point one finger towards the lens. Their expressions are joyful and exaggerated. The woman has a white bracelet on her wrist. The camera angle is fixed at eye-level throughout.
